agency.reason: Actual WLC and this Samaritan copy have the divine name. Greek angel is real ancient-version evidence, not a mistranslation to suppress. Its connected changes in action and speech, also interpretive Onkelos recasting, make explanation of a difficult divine encounter plausible without proving that explanation. There is no consulted Hebrew target attestation of מלאך. Do not insert unattested letters or certify autograph agency.
agency.countercase: Greek translation may preserve a lost Hebrew form; Hebrew absence in this bounded coverage is not proof against it. Angelic mediation is not disqualified by theology, and a smooth Hebrew form is not automatically earlier.

release_object.reason: 4Q1 published line1 preserves undotted unbracketed final nun-vav, while two preceding mems are uncertain. This direct early Hebrew evidence supports the masculine-form ending against the named Samaritan feminine ending. Narrative context favors third-person masculine over the identically written first-person-plural possibility; the OSHB first-person-plural tag is explicitly flagged, not treated as authority. Gender does not identify Moses or his son.
release_object.countercase: Samaritan from-her is a coherent alternative involving Zipporah, not a typographic non-reading. Earlier attestation is not original-priority proof, and this is a published transcription, not newly inspected ink.

action_and_speech.reason: Hiphil נגע expresses causing contact; English with-it supplies an implicit object from the cut foreskin, not an overt pronoun. Keep that inference visible. Feet possessor and address remain open. Greek falling and child-circumcision-blood declaration form a connected alternative, not interchangeable English glosses of these same Hebrew words.
action_and_speech.countercase: Ancient Greek may reflect another Hebrew source or preserve an intelligible ritual explanation lost in MT. Lack of consulted original support prevents promotion, not fair disclosure.

timing.reason: Then is lexically defensible, but its current rationale makes a subsequent utterance after release compulsory. At-that-time is equally licensed by az+qatal and less likely to impose that sequence on the repeated speech. No new pointing or consonants are selected. That-is-why asserts causality more strongly than necessary.
timing.countercase: Then can mean at-that-time in ordinary English and BDB does not exclude sequential temporal force; the change is a modest discourse clarification, not recovery of a new source or proof of retrospective authorial explanation.

circumcision_number.reason: The narrative reports one son's circumcision. Singular English can refer to that event, while an anchored note must preserve the plural Hebrew noun and possible circumcision-rites sense. Because-of is interpretive prepositional force, not sole lexical possibility; with-regard-to remains disclosed.
circumcision_number.countercase: Circumcisions more overtly renders morphology, and the plural may convey a ritual category not a count. A note is required; no claim that singular Hebrew is written here.

independent_comparison.reasons: Greek/Onkelos angel may reflect another source but no consulted Hebrew insertion is attested. Published DSS final nun-vav supports masculine-form ending; supplied line2 proves nothing. Hebrew contact/bridegroom and Greek falling/blood-declaration are distinct complete forms. At-that-time avoids compulsory second-speech inference but Then is possible. Plural English risks asserting multiple operations; disclose source plural.
independent_comparison.sensitivity: Removing modest chronological preference weakens but does not reverse local masculine preference: surrounding masculine references fit, without proving feminine secondary. Model agreement does not establish original wording.
